perennials/e1b9a7f:
Her camera reached the detail page and stopped there. The grid, the omnibox, the
companion pills and the yard list all kept painting the "no photo" flower at her
across a plant she had photographed herself, which is the guide calling her own
work an absence.

Thumb asks for it rather than each caller passing it. Every photo in the app comes
through this component, so asking here is what makes the promise good everywhere
at once: four call sites got it without being touched, and a fifth cannot forget.
It also keeps the rule in one place, since Thumb already knows whether the guide
has a photo of its own and hers is only ever offered where it does not.

useMinePhoto owns the object URL. It is a live handle into the document and
leaking one keeps a whole decoded image alive for the tab; this runs in a grid,
so that is not theoretical. AddMinePhoto had its own copy of the same effect and
now shares this one.
noodles/e1e111b:
The live echo's 8n froze at Tone's 120 bpm default because buildGraph runs
before the song tempo reaches the transport, so every song echoed off-grid
live while exports were correct; the delay now syncs at init and on tempo
changes. Pinned one-shots skipped their kit's measured trim and jumped the
mix by up to +7.5 dB; the pin now carries the trim, and user takes are
conditioned to measured per-voice library RMS targets (kick -14, snare -17,
hat -27, clap -23 dB) instead of peak-only, so a quiet-mic boom lands at
library loudness by construction. The kick duck reset the music bus to
unity before each dive (a +12 dB step, a tick on sustained pads); it now
holds the current value via cancelAndHoldAtTime. Drum swing read a cached
16th that only a melodic note refreshed, so drums-only grooves swung at
120 bpm regardless of tempo; the offset now derives from song.tempo. The
send returns landed on the master and filled the pocket the kick carved —
routed through the duck bus, the measured pump deepens from a 2.8 to a
10.5 dB median dip with the verb up (DECISIONS D8). An 18 Hz highpass now
guards the limiter from subsonics the 34 Hz bass-lane filter lets through
(the piano roll reaches C0).

Receipts: all 32 controlled space/color rows match the pre-audit build
within 0.1 dB, master combos hold -5.2..-6.3 rms at -0.2 peaks (spread
1.1 dB), dice cohesion holds at 1.8 dB spread, and render wall time shows
no regression. Calibrate now pins every device to a deterministic patch
before the preset tables — they used to inherit the cold open's random
colors, a ±1-2 dB noise floor between runs — and gets an hour of protocol
timeout since the sweep outgrew 30 minutes.
